installCommand: npx --yes pnpm@9.15.9 --prefix herledger-app install --prod=false && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules/next')) { try { fs.rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e){} try { fs.symlinkSync('herledger-app/node_modules', 'node_modules', 'junction'); } catch(e) { fs.cpSync('herledger-app/node_modules', 'node_modules', { recursive: true }); } }"
buildCommand: npx --yes pnpm@9.15.9 --prefix herledger-app db:generate && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1 npx --yes pnpm@9.15.9 --prefix herledger-app --filter web build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.next')) { try { fs.symlinkSync('herledger-app/apps/web/.next','.next','junction'); } catch(e) { fs.cpSync('herledger-app/apps/web/.next','.next',{recursive:true}); } }"
